## Course overview {#overview}

In this course, graduate students learn how to write up their own research as a paper in English. Students may use AI, but they check every AI output themselves and take responsibility for it. Lectures are in Korean, and manuscript practice is in English.

The course is for students from the first or second year of a master's programme up to the PhD. Students from wet labs and dry labs are both welcome.

When you use AI, follow the [AI use rules](ai_rules.qmd).

## Course goals {#goals}

1. Know what each part of a paper does, and write a manuscript in this order: figures → Methods → Results → Introduction → Discussion → Abstract → Title.
2. Tell apart the jobs you can give to AI from the jobs you must not, and check the sentences, references and numbers that AI produces against the original sources.
3. Find and fix English sentences that are hard to read (noun stacks, long modifiers, translationese, phrases common in AI text).
4. Write a cover letter and a response to reviewers in a set structure.

## Two tracks {#tracks}

The weekly classes are the same for both tracks. Only the text you write each week differs.

| Item | Track A: my own manuscript | Track B: rewriting a published paper |
|---|---|---|
| For | Students who have their own data and figures | Students who do not have data yet |
| What you write | A short manuscript from your own results (3–4 figures) | Choose one open-access paper. Look only at its figures and Methods, and rewrite the rest |
| Condition | Your supervisor agrees | Do not read the Results, Introduction, Discussion or Abstract until you have finished writing |
| How it is checked | Peer review and feedback from your supervisor | When you finish, compare your text with the published paper |
| What you submit | Manuscript, AI use log | Manuscript, AI use log, a note comparing your text with the published paper |

For track B, a good choice is a paper in a high-impact journal whose review record (Peer Review File) is published. Then in week 14 you can practise a response letter with the paper's real reviews. The instructor must approve the paper.

## Weekly plan {#schedule}

### Part 1 · Foundations

| Week | Topic | Assignment |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Orientation](chapters/w01_orientation.qmd) | A: list of figures / B: choose a paper |
| 2 | [AI basics](chapters/w02_ai_basics.qmd) | Verify one AI answer and bring it to class |
| 3 | [Readable English sentences](chapters/w03_readable_sentences.qmd) | Find the patterns in a paragraph written by AI |

### Part 2 · Writing the manuscript

| Week | Topic | Assignment |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | [Figure storyboard](chapters/w04_figure_storyboard.qmd) | Figure order cards |
| 5 | [Methods and figure legends](chapters/w05_methods_legends.qmd) | Draft Methods and legends |
| 6 | [Results](chapters/w06_results.qmd) | Draft Results |
| 7 | [Finding and citing literature](chapters/w07_literature.qmd) | Reference table and verification log |
| 8 | [Midterm check](chapters/w08_midterm_review.qmd) | Version revised after peer review |
| 9 | [Introduction](chapters/w09_introduction.qmd) | Draft Introduction |
| 10 | [Discussion](chapters/w10_discussion.qmd) | Draft Discussion |
| 11 | [Abstract and title](chapters/w11_abstract_title.qmd) | Abstract, and three title options |

### Part 3 · Polishing and submission

| Week | Topic | Assignment |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | [Polishing](chapters/w12_polishing.qmd) | Revised full manuscript |
| 13 | [Preparing to submit](chapters/w13_submission.qmd) | Cover letter |
| 14 | [Responding to reviewers](chapters/w14_reviewer_response.qmd) | One response letter |
| 15 | [Final](chapters/w15_final.qmd) | Manuscript, AI use log, (B) comparison note |

## Grading {#grading}

| Item | Weight |
|---|---|
| Weekly assignments | 30% |
| Final manuscript | 30% |
| AI use log | 15% |
| Peer review (weeks 8 and 12) | 15% |
| Attendance and participation | 10% |

We do not grade whether you used AI. We grade what you gave to AI and how you checked the result.

Submit assignments and the manuscript through the university LMS.
